subject: Post-call: NetGain pilot priorities, KPIs & next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Park <carolyn@netgain.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@netgain.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: NetGain pilot priorities, KPIs & next steps

Thanks again for a great call this morning — appreciate the clarity on what success looks like for NetGain. Per request, below is a concise recap and the proposed measurement plan so we can land on owners and timeline. I attached a one‑page KPI slate and a draft SLA for reference (see attachments).

Summary / objective
- Goal: Validate Redwood as primary inference runtime for NetGain’s summarization pipeline at 1M tokens/day. Focus: latency, throughput, cost/token and quality (extractive accuracy + human acceptance).

Proposed success criteria (expressed as pass/fail gates)
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 220ms for 512‑token requests under production-like traffic (baseline: current on‑prem 300ms p95).
- Throughput: Sustained 2.5k concurrent tokens/sec across 8 workers (target throughput to support peak traffic patterns).
- Cost: End‑to‑end cost <= $0.018 per 1k tokens for inference (model + infra) for the pilot volume.
- Quality: Automatic metric — ROUGE-L on holdout test set >= 0.62; Human eval — >= 88% accept rate on 200 manual samples.

Evaluation plan & phases
- Week 0 (this week): Provision sandbox in us‑west; share keys and test corpus. (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 1–2: Smoke + performance baseline (synthetic ramp + steady state). Produce p50/p95 latency and throughput curves. (Owners: Marissa + NetGain eng)
- Week 3–6: Pilot with production traffic replay and human eval window (200 samples). Capture cost breakdown (token, infra, caching). (Owners: Neha (ops) + NetGain PM)
- Week 7: Readout & decision: pass/fail on gates above; recommended rollout plan. (Owners: Rishi + NetGain execs)

Operational notes / controls
- We’ll enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts (expected cost reduction ~10–15%).
- Canary routing: we propose 10% traffic first, then 50%, then full — automated rollback on error or latency SLO breach.
- Security/compliance: we will provide SOC2 artifacts and the VPC peering worksheet this week.

Next steps / asks (action items)
1) Carolyn: confirm the 200 sample human-eval cohort and point of contact for the PM (email + calendar invite).
2) NetGain infra: provide a small representative corpus (5k canonical prompts) and one sample large request (6–8k tokens) for tail testing.
3) Marissa: share sandbox creds and quickstart runbook by EOD Monday.
4) Neha: will prepare a cost breakdown template and instrumentation checklist for logging.

Attachments: netgain-poc-kpi-slate.xlsx, redwood-pilot-sla-draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll stand up the drive folder and post the kickoff invite once Carolyn confirms the PM.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Carolyn Park <carolyn@netgain.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@netgain.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: NetGain pilot priorities, KPIs & next steps

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. This looks aligned with what we discussed. Quick clarifications: 
- The ROUGE-L target is reasonable, but can we also include a pass threshold on hallucination rate (we measured ~3.8% false entity hallucinations currently; target <=1.5%)?
- For cost, NetGain would like a conservative estimate that includes a 10% buffer for unexpected peak traffic — can you include both the expected and buffered cost in the template?

Carolyn (PM) — I’ll own the 200‑sample human eval. Tom (eng) will share the representative corpus and the large request example by end of day Monday.

Also — we need the SOC2 artifact and VPC worksheet for our procurement team; can your security contact share those to procurement@netgain.ai?

Thanks — looking forward to the sandbox.

—
Carolyn Park
Head of Product | NetGain AI
carolyn@netgain.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Park <carolyn@netgain.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@netgain.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: NetGain pilot priorities, KPIs & next steps

Great notes — appreciate the hallucination gate request. We’ll add that as an explicit quality gate: hallucination rate <= 1.5% on the 200 human eval samples.

I updated the KPI slate to show both expected cost and cost_with_buffer (+10%). Attached: netgain-poc-kpi-slate.xlsx (v2). I also uploaded SOC2 summary and the VPC worksheet to the drive link below. Security will reach out to procurement@netgain.ai with the full artifact pack by Monday.

Quick operational clarifications:
- Measurement harness: Marissa will instrument request/response logs with token counts and per-step durations. Please ensure the corpus contains the typical prompt variants (short/long/few-shot).
- Tail testing: we’ll run a 2‑hour stress window with a 4x burst multiplier for requests >2k tokens — this will exercise KV cache behavior and backend kernel selection.

I’ll schedule a kickoff for Monday 11:00 PT — provisional calendar invite attached. If that time doesn’t work, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Rishi

Attachments referenced: netgain-poc-kpi-slate-v2.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-netgain-poc
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carolyn Park <carolyn@netgain.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@netgain.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: NetGain pilot priorities, KPIs & next steps

Looping in a quick ops checklist and owners so nothing slips: 
- Sandbox creds (Marissa) — deliver by Mon EOD.
- Logging & instrumentation (Neha) — I will provide the instrumentation checklist and a lightweight Prometheus/Datadog dashboard template by Tues.
- Cost template (Neha) — I’ll populate the cost-by-component sheet with expected and +10% buffered numbers based on the pilot volume; review by Thurs.
- Human eval coordination (Carolyn) — I’ll hand over access to the eval UI and a CSV export of the 200 sample slots for annotation.

If we hit any SLO breaches during canary (latency p95 > 250ms or error rate >1.5%), we will automatically rollback and open a postmortem. Please confirm you’re comfortable with that rollback policy.

One more ask: could NetGain provide one internal stakeholder who can approve a minor quantization switch (int8) during the pilot? That will materially affect cost and latency tradeoffs.

Thanks — I’ll update the shared drive and tag owners on the kickoff invite.

—
Neha Kapoor
Principal Customer Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
